description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_ValidateAttributes, which implements a strategy for validating attributes in HTML tokens within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains a method execute() that processes a list of tokens, validating their attributes using an attribute validator, and manages context registration during processing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_ValidateAttributes
classes.description: A class implementing a validation strategy for HTML attributes within the HTMLPurifier library. It provides an execute() method that processes tokens, validating their attributes according to configuration and context.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes an array of HTML tokens, validates their attributes, and manages context registration. It only processes start and empty tokens, skipping armored tokens, and uses an attribute validator to perform validation.
